primary_dataset.count_layer: published integer UMI count table; no transformed/integrated layer
primary_dataset.tissue_compartment: placental cotyledon / villous placenta; not decidua basalis

de.fdr_method: BH within cell type and contrast

gene_sets.method: limma cameraPR competitive ranked gene-set test on signed edgeR quasi-likelihood statistic
gene_sets.fdr_method: BH across the combined frozen three-collection universe within cell type and contrast

program_classification.SHARED_PE: EOPE and LOPE FDR<0.05 with concordant NES sign
program_classification.EOPE_ENRICHED: EOPE FDR<0.05 and LOPE FDR>=0.10 or not estimable
program_classification.LOPE_ENRICHED: LOPE FDR<0.05 and EOPE FDR>=0.10 or not estimable
program_classification.UNSTABLE: opposite EOPE/LOPE NES directions when either subtype FDR<0.05, or single-subtype significance with the other subtype FDR in [0.05,0.10)

regulons.method: univariate linear model activity on signed DE statistics
regulons.fdr_method: BH within cell type and contrast

outlier_policy: flag only; never remove because disease separation improves

phase2b_gate.robust_program: program FDR<0.05 and every valid leave-one-patient-out patient-score effect retains the full effect direction
phase2b_gate.GO_TO_PHASE2B: >=2 receiver cell types each have >=3 robust programs, >=1 SHARED_PE program exists, both subtype-control groups have >=5 qualified controls, and no unresolved count-layer provenance risk
phase2b_gate.GO_TO_PHASE2B_WITH_RESTRICTIONS: >=2 receiver cell types each have >=3 robust programs and >=1 SHARED_PE program exists, but small-control or count-layer provenance restrictions remain
phase2b_gate.REMAIN_IN_PHASE2A: at least one significant program exists but robustness/shared-program criteria are not met
phase2b_gate.NO_GO: no robust significant program is identified or donor/disease identity validation fails

phase1b_integration: Phase 1B is frozen negative and is not used to select genes or programs in Phase 2A
